item.tib: mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol las rnal 'byor ri khrod 'grim pa'i cha rkyen du nyer mkho gnad kyi gdams pa zab mo
item.coloph: zhes mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyud las/ nyer mkho gnad kyi gdams pa 'di yang / sa rta zla ba drug pa'i tshes la 'ja' tshon snying pos ka ka'u seng ge yongs rdzongs (rdzong du) brtsams pa'o//
